Track your rides and connect with other equestrians, so that you and your horse can enjoy riding even more! Download the best equestrian app and join the world’s largest equestrian community, with over one million users!

Our app is used by equestrians of all levels, from Olympic riders to weekend hobby riders. They ride and train in over 50 countries across 6 continents. We empower all riders - so matter your level, Equilab can help you grow as an equestrian.

With Equilab, you can effortlessly track your training sessions just by taking your iPhone and/or Apple Watch with you when you ride. Our advanced gait analysis technology provides insights so that you and your horse(s) can continue to grow. (Equilab's Premium subscription allows users to track rides with just their standalone Apple Watch.)

Equilab also helps simplify your equestrian life. Easily join groups and connect with friends, trainers, vets, farriers, and more to share rides, schedules, and other important information. As the largest community of equestrians in the world, Equilab makes coordinating with others easy.

Download the leading horseback riding app and start:
1. Tracking every ride — use your phone or compatible Apple Watch when you ride to analyze your gait, distance, time, and more.
2. Connecting with other equestrians — chat with riders in your community or across the world to share rides, photos, and more.
3. Getting motivated — ride more to complete Challenges and earn achievements that help you and your friends grow as equestrians.
4. Celebrate progress — show off your growth as an equestrian and celebrate your friends as they grow, too.
5. Organize your life — plan your routines and coordinate trainers, vets, or co-riders with Equilab's shared calendars and groups.

7. Stay safe (Premium feature) — enable family and friends to track your location while riding so that they always know where you are.
